decisions.subject: Pipeline for this production

options_considered.label: animated-explainer
options_considered.reason: Topic-to-explainer, production stability, research-first pre-production, and the stage directors that produce a different visual design per topic.

options_considered.label: animation (motion-graphics first)
options_considered.reason: Also a fit for a fully drawn piece.
options_considered.rejected_because: The value here is the research-to-concept chain, which animated-explainer runs and animation does not.

options_considered.label: The repo's own daily/ template pipeline
options_considered.reason: Fast, gate-verified, unattended, free.
options_considered.rejected_because: It assembles a fixed vocabulary of 19 pieces, which is precisely why the last five videos were visually identical. The user asked for OpenMontage's own path instead.

decisions.reason: The user asked that production run through OpenMontage as it is rather than through the fixed template. animated-explainer is the pipeline whose directors design a fresh treatment per topic.

decisions.subject: Concept for the noise-cancelling short

options_considered.label: The Deadline Inside Your Headphones
options_considered.reason: Built on the gap the research found - the microsecond timing budget - and it explains every other beat as a consequence.

options_considered.label: Why The Engine Vanishes And The Voice Does Not
options_considered.reason: Answers the most-asked forum question with a precise, drawable answer.
options_considered.rejected_because: Absorbed into C1 as its consequence beat rather than run as a separate video.

options_considered.label: The Napkin That Took Twenty-Two Years
options_considered.reason: Human origin story with two hard numbers.
options_considered.rejected_because: Charming but it teaches nothing mechanical; kept on the shelf as its own piece.

options_considered.label: That Pressure You Feel Is Not Pressure
options_considered.reason: Corrects a bodily sensation the viewer has felt - unusually sticky.
options_considered.rejected_because: Strong enough to be its own video; folding it in would give this one two spines.

decisions.reason: One causal chain instead of a list of facts: the deadline is established, then it explains the band limit, then the reframe lands. The other three remain viable standalone videos.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime

options_considered.label: Remotion (React composition)
options_considered.reason: Available on this machine (node 22, node_modules installed). Its atelier path renders a project-local, hand-authored composition and deliberately bypasses the stock scene registry - and it enforces that bypass with a stock-reuse scan at render time, which is exactly the guarantee this run needs.

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: Also available and verified: doctor reports 0.8.27, node 22, ffmpeg and npx all resolve. Excellent at kinetic typography and GSAP motion.
options_considered.rejected_because: It is the runtime the previous five videos already used, and its lint/inspect gates are tuned to that template. Choosing the other runtime removes any chance of the old layout habits leaking in - and Remotion's atelier path has an automated doctrine check that HyperFrames does not.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.reason: Always available, zero risk.
options_considered.rejected_because: Ken Burns on stills cannot draw a waveform being cancelled. The delivery promise is motion_led, so a still-led fallback is forbidden.

decisions.reason: The brief promises motion that IS the argument, and the atelier path gives a fresh visual language per video with a machine-checked ban on reusing stock creative components. Both runtimes were available and both were assessed.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Atelier - hand-author the composition from scratch
options_considered.reason: No reusable creative components; a fresh visual language for this piece.

options_considered.label: Templated - assemble stock cut.type scene-types
options_considered.reason: Fast, cheap, reliable.
options_considered.rejected_because: It is the documented reason most videos look alike, and sameness is the exact complaint that started this run.

decisions.reason: The user's complaint was that five videos shared one look. Templated mode would reproduce that on a different engine. Atelier costs more authoring time and carries render risk; that cost is the point.

decisions.subject: Visual identity

options_considered.label: Custom art direction: oscilloscope in a dark room
options_considered.reason: Derived from the subject - the video is about a measurement, so the frame is an instrument. Cyan is the world, amber is the headphone's answer, and silence is the only still moment.

options_considered.label: minimalist-diagram preset
options_considered.reason: Genuinely close to the subject matter.
options_considered.rejected_because: A preset carries a frozen look; the taste-direction skill asks for a designed identity when the topic has its own visual world, and sound does.

options_considered.label: flat-motion-graphics preset
options_considered.reason: Standard social-media look.
options_considered.rejected_because: Bright flat shapes would flatten the one thing this video sells - precision.

decisions.reason: The subject supplies the design read. Two signal colours and a monospace number face say 'measurement' without a single label explaining it.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: Piper (local, offline)
options_considered.reason: The only configured TTS on this machine, free and offline.

options_considered.label: ElevenLabs
options_considered.reason: Best-in-class expressiveness.
options_considered.rejected_because: Unavailable - no API key on this machine, and paid, which the standing no-spend constraint forbids.

options_considered.label: Google / Gemini TTS
options_considered.reason: Natural voice on a free tier.
options_considered.rejected_because: No key present in this environment. The key lives only in the repository's Actions secrets.

decisions.reason: 1 of 10 TTS providers is configured here and it is the free local one. The script is written short and declarative to compensate for a level delivery.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free library
options_considered.reason: Available with no API key, royalty-free, and matches the user's standing requirement for free music.

options_considered.label: User's own music_library/ folder
options_considered.reason: Free and intentional if it exists.
options_considered.rejected_because: No music_library/ directory exists in this checkout.

options_considered.label: Generated music
options_considered.reason: Bespoke bed.
options_considered.rejected_because: 0 of 5 music generation providers are configured.

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Zero risk.
options_considered.rejected_because: The silence beat only reads as silence if something was playing before it.

decisions.reason: The only configured music source, and the one that satisfies the royalty-free requirement without a key or a payment.

decisions.subject: Motion requirement for the delivery promise

options_considered.label: Motion-led - the animation carries the argument
options_considered.reason: A wave being cancelled cannot be shown as a still. The motion is the explanation, not decoration.

options_considered.label: Still-led with Ken Burns
options_considered.reason: Cheaper and lower risk.
options_considered.rejected_because: Forbidden for a motion-required brief, and it would make the video meaningless.

decisions.reason: Locked at proposal so no later stage can quietly downgrade to stills if the render gets difficult.

decisions.subject: Background music

options_considered.label: Pixabay royalty-free library
options_considered.reason: Chosen at proposal as the only configured music source.
options_considered.rejected_because: Unreachable from this environment - the agent proxy denies pixabay.com and cdn.pixabay.com by policy. Not a tool bug; the tool reports available because it needs no API key.

options_considered.label: A bed produced for this video
options_considered.reason: The user's standing brief allows royalty-free OR self-produced music. A pulse rather than a melody suits a video about a clock, costs nothing, carries no third-party rights, and can be written to stop exactly where the silence beat needs it to.

options_considered.label: No music
options_considered.reason: Zero risk.
options_considered.rejected_because: The silence beat only reads as silence if something was playing before it.

decisions.reason: Revises d-007. Pixabay could not be reached at asset time, so the bed was produced locally: a 62 Hz tick every half second that doubles under the two numbers, over a low drone, ramping to nothing at 35.8s and never returning.
